correctness.rationale: Both statistics are normalized order-two U-statistics. Exact integration gives all same-pair and one-overlap moments; pair-overlap counting then yields the covariance and variances for every n. The conditional kernel means differ by an exact factor two after centering, proving degeneracy of the normalized contrast. Its same-pair variance is 1/180 and its one-overlap covariance is zero, giving the stated n^{-2} variance. An independent exact-rational checker reconstructs these moments and formulas through n=10000.

value.rationale: Gini mean difference and variance are canonical competing dispersion measures, and the inspected literature explicitly compares their statistical efficiency. Under the uniform benchmark the literature reports equal asymptotic efficiency; the new joint identity explains why by proving exact proportionality of the first-order projections. The residual discrepancy is a degenerate U-statistic with exact O(n^{-2}) variance, while the exact correlation deficit quantifies finite-sample redundancy. This is a structural coupling between two motivated estimators rather than an arbitrary moment calculation.
